$capture: POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{n}/reviews — the four answers the outcome classifier has to tell apart. These are the REST reference's documented shapes, not a live capture: obtaining a real 201 or a real 422 requires posting a review to a pull request, which this workshop is not authorised to do (E4, MN1). The 2xx body is the only one the classifier parses; the rest are classified on status alone.
